name: Type
long_description:
Type.ai is an AI story writer and editor for fantasy, sci-fi, romance, and fanfiction authors. We help authors turn their premise or manuscript in a ready-to-publish book.

Type's workflow includes a familiar chat assistant, editable story Notes that keep track of characters, relationships, and plot threads as a user's story grows, and customizable writing styles that help an author develop a unique voice.

More than 300,000 writers, from NY Times bestsellers to first-time authors, have started a story in Type.ai.
